complexity.notes: Same recurrence as before with the auxiliary array replaced by two rolling variables, dropping space from O(n) to O(1). The len(cost) == 2 special case could be folded away by seeding big and mid as 0 and letting the loop run over all indices, but the guard is harmless.
complexity.summary: Bottom-up DP scanning backward from the end, but keeping only the last two computed values in rolling variables instead of a full array, so each index's best cost is cost[i] + min(next two).
